Under a U.S. deal with the United Kingdom (UK), most UK auto imports face a 10% total U.S. tariff rate. The United States has reached deals with other partners; for example, auto imports from the EU, Japan, and South Korea face a 15% total [...] In 2025, President Donald Trump imposed 25% tariffs on U.S. imports of automobiles and certain automobile parts under Section 232. Section 232 authorizes the President to take action (e.g., tariffs, quotas, or negotiations) if the Secretary of Commerce determines that imports of a good "threaten to impair" U.S. national security. President Trump imposed auto tariffs based on the findings of a 2019 investigation, which concluded that U.S. auto imports were a threat to U.S. national security. [...] face a 15% total tariff.

Tariffs on automotive imports are based on a different law, Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962. That authority, Cox Automotive explains, “is where the real impact sits, particularly around steel, aluminum, and imported vehicles.”

Those duties, which are now 15% on cars built in Europe, South Korea, and Japan, remain in force.

Some legal observers speculate that the White House will attempt to re-enact the tariffs struck down today using Section 232 authority. results.title: Auto Tariffs & Car Prices in 2025: What Buyers Should Know - TrueCar
results.content:
Tesla has expressed concerns about the impact of the recent 25% U.S. tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts. In a letter dated March 11, 2025, Tesla informed the Trump administration that these tariffs could increase production costs for vehicles manufactured in the U.S. The company emphasized its efforts to localize the supply chain but acknowledged continued reliance on global parts sourcing.

### Pricing impact [...] ### Production impact

No changes to production or import plans have been announced at this time.

### Manufacturer response

Subaru has not announced any official response to the tariffs.

### Pricing impact

Subaru has announced that, effective May 19, pricing on select vehicles will increase. Depending on the model and trim level, the price adjustments will range from $750 to $2,055. This update reflects ongoing changes in production costs and market conditions.
